selection: 12 smallest camera ZIPs by published size; resource-bounded pilot, not representative sampling
splitUnit: camera; all dates and derivatives of a camera stay in its split
frameSelection: Sort timestamped JPEGs. Keep at most one per day with grayscale mean 45..220 and stddev >=15. Select dates at 10%, 50%, 90% of eligible ordered dates, first usable frame per date. No selection based on detector outcomes.
retention: Only max-512px PNG derivatives, URL/date/hash/license metadata; source ZIP and full-resolution frames only in memory.

pairs.recompressed: each of 3 frames x JPEG quality 40/60/80/90
pairs.edited: each frame x 3 deterministic edits: opaque patch, copy-move patch, two opaque patches; JPEG 80 output; documented masks
pairs.temporal: all 3 choose 2 date pairs, both directions
pairs.unrelated: first frame between different cameras within each split; both directions

metrics: False positive = edited verdict on non-edit pairs. Miss = edited pair not classified edited, including abstentions. Also report same-image acceptance for JPEG and temporal same-photo acceptance separately. v3 trusted+earlier-source is an explicit evaluation assumption; v2 without provenance and v2 with controlled edit provenance reported separately.
selectionRule: Calibration only: require 0 false edited verdicts on negatives and keep all existing synthetic regression tests; maximize edit recall, then JPEG same-photo acceptance, then minimize temporal same-photo acceptance; prefer smaller residual/area/count then scene closest to baseline on ties. Freeze chosen profile before evaluating validation. Report baseline and chosen on the same locked validation once, no holdout retuning.
limitations: Twelve webcams only, max512 thumbnails, not representative of press/social photos.
Constructed controlled pixel edits on real photographs, not independently collected real-world misinformation.
Repeated frames/derivatives correlated: pair rates are descriptive, not population accuracy.
